question: The radius of a circle is 21 cm. What will be the length (in cm) of an arc of the circle that subtends a 22.5° angle at the centre? [Use pi = (22)/(7)]
solution:
**Given:**

The radius of a circle is 21 cm. 

**Formula used:**

The length of the arc will be,

(θ\360) × 2 × π × r

**Calculation:** 

The length of the arc will be,

⇒ (22.5\360) × 2 × 22/7 × 21 = 8.25

**∴ The correct option is 1**
